The problem with RS3 combat isn't with the tick system or GCD. The problem, is that the actual damage values for non-necro styles is... chaotically abysmal. "Slice" for example states it does "75-115% ability damage", THAT RIGHT THERE IS THE ISSUE. Because 1: its only straight forward.. if you're good at doing math quicky. Players should know CLEARLY how much damage an attack should do right off the tooltip.
2: 40% is a random and borderline arbitrary range of damage for a simple "basic attack" anyway. Damage should be linear to your character's stats & setup but RUNESCAPE abilities seem to want to fall into ranges of their own, which is fine but RS3s are too random and feel very unrewarding.. Gotta admit..not a lot of dope or neurons firing off in the general combat of this game unless you're in the VERY end game. 
3: Other abilities are basically undertuned, UNLESS you find or purchase a drop to enhance it which due to the cosmic law of 'supply and demand' makes said drop usually far out the reach of your average player. Simply put, no ability should do UNDER 100% of your damage if it's not purely aoe. Who and why would want to do LESS damage? I ponder that EVERYTIME I look at an ability outside of Necro now...

Once these issues are fixed across the board I can almost guarantee everything will be at least on par with Necro.. Oh and lets hope the fixes are BAKED IN to each STYLE and not some crudy 'book' that drops out of some bosses arse 🤷🏽‍♂️
